# Pinned PAR2 distribution

This directory contains the unmodified **par2cmdline-turbo 1.5.0** Windows x64 executable, its complete corresponding source distribution, and GPL-2.0-or-later COPYING file. The tool runs as a separate process and is not linked into the managed application.

Official upstream: https://github.com/animetosho/par2cmdline-turbo/releases/tag/v1.5.0

| File | SHA-256 |

| Official `par2cmdline-turbo-1.5.0-win-x64.zip` | `873a6f25822415f432224cc6f734407ca2732004184e002960fc68ed1e99c5d7` |
| Extracted `par2.exe` | `36ce11d92c895a552485ba8cb1ad4b92ca62a00333f1aa6308daafbc371e69e9` |
| `par2cmdline-turbo-1.5.0.tar.xz` | `035584144d3ac3b08fb5d7d4b844f60cf97404b6469f6aed7d9b9430a25bef0e` |

The ZIP and source hashes were checked against the official GitHub release asset digests before the executable was used. At runtime the extracted executable is checked against the pinned executable hash again.

The executable, complete source archive and license are embedded in every published 2Password application and generated self-extractor. Export the complete source using the application's third-party notices dialog, or `2Password.exe --export-recovery-source <new-output.tar.xz>`. Public releases also ship the source archive as a separate asset. The source archive includes upstream build instructions and bundled computational sources. No network download is needed to use recovery or export these sources.
